description: §6.6.19 — a `const <name>` derived cell whose RHS reaches a binding imported from a §12.2 Trigger 3 escalation-server-only stdlib module (`hashPassword` from `scrml:auth`) is REFUSED with E-DERIVED-SERVER-ONLY-REACH, not escalated. Guards the S331 leak where this shape compiled at exit 0 with no `.server.js` and shipped a real `Bun.password.hash` argon2id implementation into the browser bundle.
rationale: §6.6.19: escalation is not an available answer for a derived cell — §6.6.3 fixes the evaluation strategy as synchronous lazy pull with dirty flags, so making the recompute a server round trip is not expressible. §12.2 Trigger 3 escalates the FUNCTION that reaches such a binding, and §12.4's per-function scope is exactly why the derived position was missed. The compiler therefore refuses. E-ROUTE-005 does NOT fire: that code is the unplaceable single-FUNCTION shape and additionally requires a client-only DOM global, neither of which is present here.
